axeViolations.description: Ensures the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA contrast ratio thresholds
axeViolations.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds

nodes.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 1.85 (foreground color: #bbbbbb, background color: #ffffff, font size: 11.0pt (14.6667px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1
